references.context: Scalars are complex numbers with complex conjugation, needed for Hermitian sesquilinearity.
Form linear in the first argument, conjugate-linear in the second and conjugate symmetric across slots.
For every nonzero v, ⟨v,v⟩ is strictly positive real, and ⟨v,v⟩=0 iff v=0.

references.disposition: This is one of two standard conventions; this source explicitly chooses first-slot linearity, not second-slot linearity.

review_rationale: Read complex inner product over a complex vector space using positive-definite Hermitian form, linearity in first slot, conjugate linearity in second and explicit convention.
